Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ رَجَبٍ وَشَعْبَانَ
Translation: O Allah, bless us in Rajab and Sha'ban
And enable us to reach the month of Ramadan
And help us in fasting and prayer

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ حَظَّنَا مِنْهُ الْجُوعَ وَالْعَطَشَ
Translation: And do not make our share from it merely hunger and thirst
